definitions: The liquid obtained from pressing fruit or vegetables.
The natural fluid part of an animal or plant substance.
Informal term for electric current or power.
Informal term for petrol or fuel.
Informal term for the essential quality or character of something; vigour or vitality.
examples: Orange juice is a popular breakfast drink.
The meat was full of juice.
Is there any juice left in the battery?
The story lost its juice over time.
